extracted.intended_audience: researchers, policymakers, students, and analysts seeking country-level demographic, energy, and economic statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Tabular country-level statistics covering median age, proved oil and natural gas reserves, natural gas production/consumption/trade, internet hosts, and gross fixed investment as percent of GDP, with year-of-estimate annotations. Useful for comparative analysis, reporting, and reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age (years)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-country median age values given as total, male, and female, with year of estimate (e.g., 'total: 20.1 years; male: 19.7 years; female: 20.7 years (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each country line shows three breakdowns (total/male/female) and a parenthetical year-of-estimate. Values may be identical for sexes in some entries. Page footer notes 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - proved reserves (bbl)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proved oil reserves by country expressed in barrels with a reference date (format: e.g., '13.1 billion bbl (1 January 2002)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values include country-level figures, some zero entries, and aggregate/world totals (e.g., 'World 1.025 trillion bbl (1 January 2002)'). Each entry specifies the reference date (often 1 January 2002, sometimes 2003 or 2004). Units are barrels (bbl).

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - proved reserves (cu m)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proved natural gas reserves by country expressed in cubic meters with a reference date (e.g., '4.739 trillion cu m (1 January 2002)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country-level figures include zeros for some countries and a World total (e.g., 'World 161.2 trillion cu m (1 January 2002)'). Reference dates are shown for each line (mostly 1 January 2002). Units: cubic meters (cu m).

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - production (cu m)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual natural gas production by country (estimate year indicated) expressed in cubic meters (e.g., '33.08 billion cu m (2001 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries provide country production and the year of estimate (commonly 2001 est.). Some countries report '0 cu m' or NA. Units: cubic meters. A World aggregate is included ('World 2.578 trillion cu m (2001 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - consumption (cu m)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual natural gas consumption by country (estimate year indicated) expressed in cubic meters (e.g., '27.4 billion cu m (2001 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country-level consumption figures include the estimate year (mostly 2001 est.), zero or NA where applicable, and a World total (e.g., 'World 2.555 trillion cu m (2001 est.)'). Units: cubic meters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - imports (cu m)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual natural gas imports by country (estimate year indicated) expressed in cubic meters (e.g., '78.73 billion cu m (2001 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country entries show imported volumes with a year-of-estimate (commonly 2001 est.), many zeros for non-importing countries, special notes for some entries (e.g., origin of imports), and a World aggregate ('World 697.5 billion cu m (2001 est.)'). Units: cubic meters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - exports (cu m)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual natural gas exports by country (estimate year indicated) expressed in cubic meters (e.g., '205.4 billion cu m (2001 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries include country export volumes with the estimate year (mostly 2001 est.), many zeros where applicable, and a World total (e.g., 'World 712 billion cu m (2001 est.)'). Units: cubic meters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet hosts
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of Internet hosts by country with year of measurement in parentheses (e.g., 'Australia 2,847,763 (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values are integer host counts for given years (various years, commonly 2003–2004); some entries use 'NA' or include explanatory notes (e.g., 'European Union 22,000,414 (2004); note - sum of individual country Internet hosts').

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed) (% of GDP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross fixed investment as a percentage of GDP reported by country with the year of estimate (e.g., 'China 43.4% of GDP (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country-level percentages reference a specific year (commonly 2003). Entries vary widely and include small-states and aggregates (e.g., 'European Union percent of GDP - NA (2004 est.)'). Units: percent of GDP.
